body: SwiftUI profile host must mount on first real layout, not at init. ChatProfileRootController builds ChatProfileMainView in its property initializer, so a synchronous mount lands at bounds .zero with no parent VC and no safe area — the nav bar and hero then re-lay out mid-push (the header shift). renderSwiftUIProfile now guards on non-zero bounds; layoutSubviews mounts and attaches.
author: Vibe Team
